sentences.en: The umpire was partial to the team from his country.
sentences.zh: 这位裁判偏向他所在国家的球队。

sentences.en: Do not, under any circumstances, depend on a partial feeling.
sentences.zh: 在任何情况下都不要依赖一种偏见。

sentences.en: That teacher tends to be partial to female students.
sentences.zh: 那位老师倾向于偏爱女学生。

senses.zh: 部分的，不完全的；偏袒的，不公平的；偏爱的
